_comment: Single source for /cases/ and the anonymous case pages under /case/<slug>/. Built by scripts/build-casebank.mjs. Published cases need consent_confirmed. Anonymous cases must never carry a client name anywhere on the page: the build checks the names listed in forbiddenNames. Never publish a commission rate.

cases.display_name: A Norwegian private specialist clinic group
cases.period: 1 February to 16 October 2026, against the same days in 2025
cases.headline: 28% more bookings at 17% lower cost per booking
cases.situation: Eleven broad campaigns, with Performance Max taking a large share of spend and partly capturing searches for the clinic's own name.
what_we_did: Took over the account on 25 January 2026.
Rebuilt it into one campaign per treatment area.
Switched off Performance Max and fixed tracking so only completed online bookings count.
cases.what_it_does_not_show: Attendance: these are online bookings, and phone bookings come on top. That we caused all of it: cost per booking had already fallen in autumn 2025. Over half of bookings come from searches for the clinic's name, which we do not take credit for. Bookings for the outpatient clinic fell 31% after Performance Max was switched off.
cases.source: The clinic group's Google Ads and Google Analytics accounts, 1 February to 16 October 2026 against the same days in 2025. 42 days with a tracking fault in July and August are left out of both years.

cases.display_name: A Norwegian family and inheritance law firm
cases.headline: Cost per enquiry contact down from NOK 642 to NOK 162

metrics.label: ad cost per phone or email contact, 2024 to 2026
of enquiries become clients (the firm's figure)
covers about eight months of ad spend

cases.situation: Before 2024 the account counted page views as conversions, so nobody could see what the advertising produced.
what_we_did: Rebuilt measurement around phone and email contacts.
Ran search campaigns by practice area and city.
Cut monthly spend from about NOK 20,000 to about NOK 9,500 while cost per contact kept falling.
cases.what_it_does_not_show: How many clients the ads produced: a contact click is not an enquiry, and the firm's own volume includes referrals and searches for its name. UK prices.
cases.source: The firm's Google Ads account, January 2024 to 17 October 2026. Close rate and average fee as reported by the firm.

cases.headline: About 59 new instructions from form enquiries alone

metrics.label: of ad enquiries became instructions (the firm's figure)
in ad spend per new instruction

cases.situation: Business law clients searching for a firm, with no measurement of what search advertising produced.
what_we_did: Built search campaigns around business law.
Measured form submissions and phone clicks separately.
cases.what_it_does_not_show: Phone clicks (275) are not counted, because a click is not a call. Volume fell in the last six months of the period. UK prices.
cases.source: The firm's Google Ads account, October 2023 to May 2025. Close rate as reported by the firm. 91 form enquiries at 65% is about 59 instructions; NOK 172,900 of ad spend over 59 is about NOK 2,930, or £233.
